rows.district_legal_services_authority_kamare: Office of the Legal Aid Defense Counsel, District Legal Services Authority, Kamareddy

Graduate from any recognized University with basic word processing skills, ability to operate computer and feed data, good typing speed with proper setting of petition, ability to take dictation and prepare files for Courts, and knowledge in maintenance and processing of files.
Must not have completed the age of 44 years (as on 1 September 2026)
Chairperson, District Legal Services Authority, Court Buildings, Kamareddy-503111

content_sections.heading: DLSA Kamareddy Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 06/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DLSA Kamareddy notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Must be a graduate from any recognized University; Basic Word Processing Skills and ability to operate computer and skills to feed data; Good typing speed with proper setting of petition; Ability to take dictation and prepare files for presentation in the Courts; Knowledge in maintenance and processing files Age limit: Must not have completed the age of 44 years (as on 1 September 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/BC/EWS 5 years Other conditions: Only eligible candidates of Kamareddy District are invited Must be of sound health, active habits and free from bodily defects or infirmities rendering unfit for service Character and antecedents condition as printed in the notice Must be a citizen of India Candidates must furnish their phone numbers for correspondence

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DLSA Kamareddy Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Persons awarded any punishment for misconduct in disciplinary proceedings while in service

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract basis Initially for a period of one year or any date before that May be continued till further orders if the need arises, as fixed by the Chairperson

content_sections.heading: DLSA Kamareddy Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for the journey Applications with insufficient information will be rejected Mere applying does not guarantee selection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificates of academic qualification: marks list, pass, provisional certificates, testimonials and technical efficiency certificates, if any Date of Birth Certificate Community Certificate for SCs/STs/BCs/EWSs issued by the competent authority Employment Registration Card (if available) Certificate of Local/Non-Local candidature in terms of Presidential Order, 1975 Self-addressed registered post cover with acknowledgment worth Rs.70/- or as fixed by the Postal Department for RPAD

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Kamareddy Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed application form enclosed with the notification. Affix a recent colour passport size photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer. Enclose proofs for date of birth, qualifications, community, PH/ESM status and employment registration as the form asks. Send the application in a sealed cover addressed to Chairperson, District Legal Services Authority, Court Buildings, Kamareddy-503111. Mention on the application for which post applied. Applications received after 5.00 PM on 28.11.2026 will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Particulars furnished in the application form will be taken as final Applicants for more than one post may be selected to any of the posts applied No information will be sent to unsuccessful candidates; no correspondence will be entertained The notification may be cancelled at any stage without assigning any reason

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Kamareddy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DLSA Kamareddy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Office Assistant/Clerk.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DLSA Kamareddy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application form enclosed with the notification (page 3)) and send it to Chairperson, District Legal Services Authority, Court Buildings, Kamareddy-503111, by sealed cover by post, to reach by 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is must not have completed the age of 44 years (as on 1 September 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/BC/EWS 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate from any recognized University with basic word processing skills, ability to operate computer and feed data, good typing speed with proper setting of petition, ability to take dictation and prepare files for Courts, and knowledge in maintenance and processing of files.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only eligible candidates of Kamareddy District are invited. Must be of sound health, active habits and free from bodily defects or infirmities rendering unfit for service. Character and antecedents condition as printed in the notice. Must be a citizen of India.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons awarded any punishment for misconduct in disciplinary proceedings while in service.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Method of selection to be decided by the Chairperson depending upon the number of applications received. Method of selection will be decided depending upon the number of applications received.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis. Initially for a period of one year or any date before that. May be continued till further orders if the need arises, as fixed by the Chairperson.
